capabilities: Export the current note to .docx from the command palette or file menu
Preserve theme and CSS snippet styling, callouts, code colors and tables in Word output
Convert math to native, editable Word equations and footnotes to Word footnotes
Reuse PDF export page settings or configure page size, margins and scale separately
Turn headings into Word heading styles with bookmarks and keep heading links clickable
extras: Desktop only; reads system font folders read-only to match Word line heights; makes no network requests except fetching remotely embedded images; not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: uses the page size, margins, title and scale last chosen in Obsidian's Export to PDF dialog
problem: Obsidian can export styled PDFs but has no built-in way to produce Word documents with the same look, so sharing notes as editable .docx requires manual reformatting.

relations.evidence: Emit the model as .docx with docx

summary: Exports notes to Word .docx files that mirror Obsidian's PDF export styling, with editable headings, tables, equations and footnotes.
